title: 200 Hour Yin Yoga Teacher Training Course in Uluwatu Bali
metaTitle: 200 Hour Yin Yoga Teacher Training in Uluwatu Bali | RYS-200
metaDescription: Immerse in a 200-hour Yin Yoga Teacher Training in Uluwatu, Bali, where tranquility, deep anatomy & restoration meet Yoga Alliance certification
summary: Our training mixes theory (like yoga philosophy and anatomy) with hands-on teaching practice, so you graduate ready to lead classes with confidence.
intro: 200 Hour Yin Yoga Teacher Training Uluwatu is the perfect counter to today’s busy life. In Uluwatu’s tranquil setting, you’ll practice using props like bolsters and blankets to make poses comfortable and safe. Our training mixes theory (like yoga philosophy and anatomy) with hands-on teaching practice, so you graduate ready to lead classes with confidence.
Whether you’re deepening your practice or starting a new career, Uluwatu’s natural beauty and our supportive training will inspire growth.

Yin Yoga is based on Traditional Chinese Medicine and Taoist Yin and Yang philosophy. Yin Yoga is practiced on the connective tissue of the body, especially the fascia, tendons and ligaments, with the holding of the asana for 3-5 minutes or more, making it possible to address the body and even emotional issues.

curriculum.title: Pranayama Syllabus
items: Yin Postures for Pranayama Practice (Comfort, support & stillness emphasized)
Jal Neti (Yogic Nasal Cleansing) – Yin Approach
Sutra Neti (Yogic Nasal Cleansing) – Yin-Informed Approach
Sūrya Bhedana & Chandra Bhedī Prāṇāyāma (Solar & Lunar Breathing)
Antar Kumbhaka & Bahir Kumbhaka (Inner & Outer Breath Retention)

curriculum.title: Meditation Syllabus
items: Emotional & Mental Landscape in Yin Meditation
Kīrtan Spiritual Dancing Meditation (Devotion in Sound, Movement & Awareness)
Ardha Padmāsana (Half Lotus Pose) (Seated Meditation Posture)

curriculum.title: Yin Anatomy Syllabus
items: Kati Basti – Lower Back Pain Treatment Practice

curriculum.title: Yin Asanas with Alignment / Adjustment / Methodology
Intermediate – Yang Asanas
items: Virabhadrasana I, II, III, IV (Warrior Series)
Ardha Matsyendrasana (Half Lord of the Fishes Pose)

curriculum.title: Advanced – Yang Asanas
items: Eka Pada Baka Dhyanasana (One-Legged Crow Pose)
Dwi Hasta Bhujasana (Two Hands and Arms Pose)
Eka Hasta Bhujasana (One Hand and Arm Pose)
Ardha Baddha Padmottanasana (Half Bound Lotus Forward Fold)

curriculum.title: Philosophy Syllabus
items: What Is Yin? Meaning, Essence & Goal
Patanjali Yoga Sutras Through a Yin Lens
Overview of the Four Chapters (Pāda) – Yin Perspective
Eight Limbs of Yoga – Yin Interpretation
Understanding the Four Paths of Yoga (Integrated & Yin Perspective)
Who Is the Buddha? / Meaning of “Buddha”
Trigunas – Sattva, Rajas, and Tamas / What Are the Trigunas?
What Is Kundalinī Yoga? / Meaning of Kundalinī
Teaching of Ramana Maharshi – “Who Am I?”
India – The Birthplace of Yoga/ Rishikesh – The World Capital of Yoga

dining.text: Every meal is freshly prepared using wholesome plant-based ingredients with the highest standards of hygiene, cleanliness, and mindfulness. Our sattvic cuisine supports your yoga practice by nourishing the body, calming the mind, and promoting inner balance throughout your training.
mealTimes: Lunch & Dinner are not served on Sundays.

arrival: In order for you to rest properly before the opening ceremony on the 1st day of the course, the check-in to the school should be one day before the course begins. Your check-in time must be between 10 AM to 4 PM. We provide you a complimentary stay for that night. Your check-out on the last day of the course must be between 12 PM to 2 PM.

policies.title: Booking
items: Advance booking fee: In order to book the course, you are required to deposit the booking fee. We accept the booking fee via Razorpay | Western Union | bank transfer or TransferWise. An official booking confirmation letter will be sent to you shortly after successful advance deposit; the balance of the course fees can be paid on arrival at school either by credit card, debit card or cash.
